svg.title: Selected work. FSE Emilia-Romagna & Calabria: Regional electronic health records, built to WCAG 2.1 (Health). SEAREN / TCMS: Maritime surveillance and search and rescue for NATO (Defense). DIMOS: EU election and governance platform (Elections). Italia Expo Osaka 2025: Platform for the Italian pavilion, Angular SSR with Drupal (Expo). DMS: Document management with 3D BIM, built as Native Federation micro-frontends (Construction). FIFA World Cup 2022: Event platform at MICEtribe, peaking at 5M+ concurrent users (Events). Geneva Motor Show: Event platform at MICEtribe (Events).
